description: pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs:161-167: after has_delta_crl_indicator() succeeds, the code calls base_crl_number(&delta_crl) and then checks is_none() with an early return. Idiomatic Rust: delta_base_num should be obtained via .ok_or(Error::CrlParseError(der::Error::from(der::ErrorKind::Failed)))? on the call that decodes the INTEGER, eliminating the separate is_none() branch and making the intent clearer.
title: crl.rs: is_none() guard should be ok_or()?
